segments.t: korTTY is developed openly on GitHub: KTPH000https://github.com/chardonnay/korTTYKTPH001. Bug reports and feature ideas are both handled as GitHub issues. You need a free GitHub account to open an issue.

KTPH000Search for existing reportsKTPH001 first at KTPH002https://github.com/chardonnay/korTTY/issuesKTPH003 (include closed issues) — your problem may already be known or even fixed in a newer release.
The korTTY version — shown in KTPH000Help KTPH002 AboutKTPH001 and in the footer of this manual.
Your operating system and version (e.g. macOS 15, Windows 11, Ubuntu 24.04).
Exact steps to reproduce the problem, what you expected, and what happened instead.
A relevant excerpt from the application log KTPH000 (see KTPH001Configuration filesKTPH002) and, for crashes, any crash report your OS produced.
A screenshot if the problem is visual.

KTPH000Open the issueKTPH001 at KTPH002https://github.com/chardonnay/korTTY/issues/newKTPH003: use a short, specific title (e.g. KTPH004"SFTP tab freezes when renaming a file on Windows 11"KTPH005), paste the collected facts into the description, and submit it.
KTPH000Stay reachableKTPH001 — follow-up questions on the issue are common; enable GitHub notifications for it.
Log files and screenshots can contain sensitive information such as hostnames, usernames, file paths or session details. Review and redact everything you attach to a public GitHub issue.
Check KTPH000https://github.com/chardonnay/korTTY/issuesKTPH001 for similar suggestions first — add a comment or a 👍 reaction there instead of opening a duplicate.
Open a new issue at KTPH001https://github.com/chardonnay/korTTY/issues/newKTPH002 with a title starting with KTPH000 (e.g. KTPH003"Feature: bookmark folders in the connection manager"KTPH004).

Describe the KTPH000use caseKTPH001 — what you are trying to accomplish and why the current behavior falls short — rather than only the solution you have in mind. Mockups or examples from other tools are welcome.
Release notes for shipped changes are collected in KTPH000Release notesKTPH001.
